policy: Strict claim governance: every engineering and scientific statement must be traceable to empirical evidence.

claims.claim: Condition-aware scaling narrows nominal out-of-sample undercoverage and improves worst-stratum coverage to 89.78%.
limitations: Point estimate 93.67% remains below 95.0% target; full safety requires refusal gating beyond 8.0m.
claims.allowed_wording: Condition-aware scaling improved nominal OOS coverage from 92.61% to 93.67% [95% CI: 91.55%-95.28%], narrowing undercoverage.

claims.claim: Multi-trigger boundary gating achieves 100% appropriate refusal on tested out-of-ODD violations with zero false refusals on nominal frames.
limitations: Evaluated on N=150 boundary stress fixtures.
claims.allowed_wording: The safe refusal engine achieved 100% appropriate refusal across 150 boundary violations while preserving nominal throughput.

claims.claim: Perception F1 achieves 88.45% across 4 physical warehouse sectors using exact object-level denominators.
limitations: Evidence is established within 1 physical facility across 4 sectors; multi-facility generalization remains an open gap.
claims.allowed_wording: Object-level perception F1 was 88.45% across 4 sectors within Facility Central.

claims.claim: Trajectory-level tracking IDF1 achieves 91.80% [95% CI: 90.57%-92.95%] evaluated via non-parametric trajectory bootstrap.
limitations: 28 trajectory sequences evaluated; resampled via 1000 trajectory bootstrap replicates.
claims.allowed_wording: Tracking IDF1 is estimated at 91.80% [Bootstrap 95% CI: 90.57%-92.95%].

claims.claim: Enforcing UNKNOWN identity state during ambiguous crossing prevents forced incorrect associations and safely downgrades action.
limitations: Tested on N=10 ambiguous crossing episodes.
claims.allowed_wording: The system assigns an UNKNOWN state and downgrades hazard action to advisory warning when identity is ambiguous.

claims.claim: Intervention evidence encompasses 6 discrete case studies (including 1 physical new case) with causal refusal under parallel-trend violation.
limitations: N=6 cases represent discrete episodes; population causal inference is not supported.
claims.allowed_wording: Across 6 evaluated intervention case studies, 3 exhibited risk redistribution, 1 reduced risk, 1 created a new hazard, and 1 refused causal attribution.
